entries.title: Isaiah 60:1
segments: ¶Arise, shine; For your light has come! And the glory of the LORD is risen upon you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:2
segments: For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, And deep darkness the people; But the LORD will arise over you, And His glory will be seen upon you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:3
segments: The Gentiles shall come to your light, And kings to the brightness of your rising.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:4
segments: "Lift up your eyes all around, and see: They all gather together, they come to you; Your sons shall come from afar, And your daughters shall be nursed at [your] side.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:5
segments: Then you shall see and become radiant, And your heart shall swell with joy; Because the abundance of the sea shall be turned to you, The wealth of the Gentiles shall come to you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:6
segments: The multitude of camels shall cover your [land], The dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; All those from Sheba shall come; They shall bring gold and incense, And they shall proclaim the praises of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:7
segments: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together to you, The rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; They shall ascend with acceptance on My altar, And I will glorify the house of My glory.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:8
segments: "Who [are] these [who] fly like a cloud, And like doves to their roosts?

entries.title: Isaiah 60:9
segments: ¶Surely the coastlands shall wait for Me; And the ships of Tarshish [will come] first, To bring your sons from afar, Their silver and their gold with them, To the name of the LORD your God, And to the Holy One of Israel, Because He has glorified you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:10
segments: "The sons of foreigners shall build up your walls, And their kings shall minister to you; For in My wrath I struck you, But in My favor I have had mercy on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:11
segments: Therefore your gates shall be open continually; They shall not be shut day or night, That [men] may bring to you the wealth of the Gentiles, And their kings in procession.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:12
segments: For the nation and kingdom which will not serve you shall perish, And [those] nations shall be utterly ruined.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:13
segments: "The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, The cypress, the pine, and the box tree together, To beautify the place of My sanctuary; And I will make the place of My feet glorious.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:14
segments: Also the sons of those who afflicted you Shall come bowing to you, And all those who despised you shall fall prostrate at the soles of your feet; And they shall call you The City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:15
segments: ¶"Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, So that no one went through [you], I will make you an eternal excellence, A joy of many generations.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:16
segments: You shall drink the milk of the Gentiles, And milk the breast of kings; You shall know that I, the LORD, [am] your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:17
segments: "Instead of bronze I will bring gold, Instead of iron I will bring silver, Instead of wood, bronze, And instead of stones, iron. I will also make your officers peace, And your magistrates righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:18
segments: Violence shall no longer be heard in your land, Neither wasting nor destruction within your borders; But you shall call your walls Salvation, And your gates Praise.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:19
segments: "The sun shall no longer be your light by day, Nor for brightness shall the moon give light to you; But the LORD will be to you an everlasting light, And your God your glory.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:20
segments: Your sun shall no longer go down, Nor shall your moon withdraw itself; For the LORD will be your everlasting light, And the days of your mourning shall be ended.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:21
segments: Also your people [shall] all [be] righteous; They shall inherit the land forever, The branch of My planting, The work of My hands, That I may be glorified.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:22
segments: A little one shall become a thousand, And a small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will hasten it in its time."
